skill_name: Compose an essay in the form of an argument defending the motion that robots should be included in the workplace.
workflow: Robots should be included in the workplace, as they have the potential to revolutionize the way we do business. Automation and robotics have become increasingly important in the modern world, and by using robots as employees, businesses and organizations could benefit in many ways. Firstly, robots are not subject to human-related issues, such as fatigue or sickness, meaning tasks are sure to be completed faster and with a near-perfect accuracy rate.
